# github-api

Orchestrates GitHub API access across all services. Intelligently routes API operations to specialised resource files covering authentication, repositories, issues/PRs, workflows, security, and more. Use when implementing GitHub integrations, automating operations, or building applications that interact with GitHub.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r github-api ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r github-api .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `resources/issues-pull-requests.md`
- `resources/repositories.md`
- `resources/rest-api-basics.md`
- `resources/search-content.md`
- `resources/security-webhooks.md`
- `resources/users-organizations-teams.md`
- `resources/workflows-actions.md`

## Part of a larger set

One of the API skills (`claude-skills-api`). See the [group's list](../../README.md),
